say: In 1943, Britain's most important secret agent was already dead.
tts: In nineteen forty-three, Britain's most important secret agent was already dead.
direction: with a dramatic beat before 'already dead'

say: The Allies were about to invade Sicily. The problem? Everyone could see it coming. So British intelligence came up with a plan that sounds completely made up.

voice.name: Orus
voice.style: Say it like a sly British intelligence officer in 1943, quick and conspiratorial

voice.name: Puck
voice.style: Say it like a sly British intelligence officer in 1943, quick and conspiratorial

say: ...and chain fake invasion plans to his wrist.

voice.name: Orus
voice.style: Say it like a sly British intelligence officer in 1943, quick and conspiratorial

say: The fake plans said the real targets were Greece and Sardinia. They found a homeless Welshman who had died in London, and gave him a whole new life.
Major William Martin. A fiancée named Pam, with love letters. Theatre tickets. Even an angry letter from his bank.
direction: a quick list, with a comic beat before 'Even an angry letter from his bank'

say: In April 1943, a submarine slipped him into the sea off the coast of Spain. Spanish fishermen found him. Within days, the Germans had copies of the plans.
tts: In April nineteen forty-three, a submarine slipped him into the sea off the coast of Spain. Spanish fishermen found him. Within days, the Germans had copies of the plans.

say: Hitler took the bait, and rushed reinforcements to Greece and Sardinia. In July, the Allies landed on Sicily, the one place the plans said they wouldn't.
The man who fooled Hitler was buried in Spain as Major Martin. Decades later, his real name was added to the grave: Glyndwr Michael.
tts: The man who fooled Hitler was buried in Spain as Major Martin. Decades later, his real name was added to the grave: Glin-DOOR Michael.
direction: respectful and a little slower at the very end
